title: 'Iran is going to get a beating': Trump threatens 'hard' response after attack on US base
content: United States President Donald Trump warned Iran of a forceful military response. American bases in Jordan faced missile attacks which the US intercepted. Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed responsibility for the attempted surprise strike. US and Saudi forces also conducted overnight strikes against Iran-backed militias. Global markets reacted to the latest escalation in the Middle East.

title: 'Illegally occupied': Indian Embassy in US slams foreign media for calling PoK 'Pakistani Kashmir'
content: The Indian Embassy criticized The New York Times for its inaccurate reporting.  The embassy stated Pakistan illegally occupies parts of Jammu and Kashmir.  Violent clashes have occurred in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir since early June.  Protests are ongoing over regional legislative assembly seats and alleged manipulation.  India attributes these protests to Pakistan's economic exploitation and oppression.

title: Watch: Terrifying one-punch knockout at CWG leaves boxer hanging through ropes
content: Orlando Holley-Sotomi of Wales delivered a powerful knockout during the Commonwealth Games boxing quarterfinal.  His opponent, Refiloe Thai, was sent through the ropes after a devastating right hand landed.  Medical staff quickly attended to the injured boxer, who thankfully showed signs of recovery.  This victory guarantees Holley-Sotomi at least a bronze medal in the competition.

title: MP farmers breach barricades, reach within 1 km of CM Mohan Yadav's residence over moong MSP
content: Farmers in Bhopal protested over summer moong procurement at minimum support price. They breached police barricades and marched towards the Chief Minister's residence. The state government formed a committee to discuss issues with farmer representatives. Talks between the agriculture minister and farmer leaders concluded without a breakthrough. The protest continued with various demonstrations and roadside activities.

title: Hyderabad: Trainee IPS officer arrested for sexual harassment of co-trainee
content: A trainee IPS officer was arrested for allegedly harassing a woman co-trainee. The accused faces charges of stalking and sexual harassment at the police academy. He reportedly sent abusive messages and made derogatory remarks to the complainant. The woman also alleged physical assault and blackmail attempts by the officer. Police registered a case under relevant sections of the law.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
content: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. Manufacturers report significant sales growth across several European countries. This shift is driven by both comfort and public health concerns. Rising temperatures and extreme heat events are becoming impossible to ignore. Cultural attitudes towards cooling solutions are beginning to change.

title: Kanpur man kills wife, applies sindoor on her head before hanging self
content: In a tragic incident in Kanpur, a newly married couple, Saurabh Savita and Shalini, were found dead in their rented room. Police speculate that Saurabh may have strangled Shalini before taking his own life, applying vermilion, a symbol of marital status. Their court marriage, done in secrecy without familial approval, had caused considerable tension within their families. Investigations are ongoing to uncover the motive behind this heartbreaking situation.

title: Apollo butterfly made a comeback, then overgrown habitat threatened it
content: Czech conservationists revived the Apollo butterfly population in 1986.  The species population grew beyond two thousand individuals, showing conservation success.  However, habitat succession later reduced essential sunlight and open conditions.  This overgrown vegetation threatened the butterfly's larval food plants and survival.  Long-term habitat management is crucial for species recovery and future stability.

title: 170 years of records show where Canada’s kelp forests survive best
content: Recent historic charts and satellite data illustrate the impressive durability of kelp forests on Vancouver Island. In cooler, wave-exposed zones, eighty-eight percent of kelp survived over a century, while warmer, sheltered waters faced a concerning decline to fifty-two percent. These insights reveal crucial regional variations in kelp forest resilience amid rising temperatures and serve as pivotal guidance for future conservation initiatives aimed at protecting these essential marine ecosystems.

title: JPMorgan CEO recalls his Citigroup firing: Shares meeting with mentor Sandy Weill
content: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon discussed two major life events.  His 1998 Citigroup dismissal reshaped his career path significantly. His youngest daughter asked if the family would now have to “sleep on the streets”. A near-fatal heart emergency in 2020 brought him peace.  Dimon invested heavily in Bank One after leaving Citigroup.  This bold move led to his leadership at JPMorgan Chase.

title: Meta tells IT ministry PM Modi's posts will get additional oversight, senior reviews
content: Meta assured the government of enhanced oversight for Prime Minister Modi's posts. This assurance followed the brief removal of his video addressing the NEET paper leak issue. The company admitted the video's temporary removal was due to an unintended error. Prime Minister Modi had discussed stricter measures against paper leaks in the video. Meta officials will meet government representatives soon to discuss this incident further.

title: Neymar confirms Brazil retirement: 'My time with the national team is over'
content: Neymar has officially confirmed his retirement from international football after a long career.  His decision follows Brazil's recent exit from the FIFA World Cup tournament.  The veteran forward ends his international journey with numerous goals and assists.  He also addressed and dismissed recent dressing-room criticism reports.  Neymar helped Santos secure a victory in the Copa Sudamericana match.

title: Inside US-Saudi nuclear deal: Why Pakistan is biggest loser
content: The newly forged nuclear pact between the US and Saudi Arabia promises to transform the atomic dynamics in the region. This agreement grants Saudi Arabia the ability to enrich uranium domestically, supervised by the United States, effectively diminishing Pakistan's nuclear dominance. The emergence of a nuclear triangle comprising Israel, Iran, and Saudi Arabia signals a significant shift in U.S. non-proliferation efforts, embracing a tiered regional order.

title: No proof Nicki Nicole dated Lamine Yamal for publicity despite viral claim
content: The viral claim that Nicki Nicole admitted dating Lamine Yamal only for publicity is false. No credible interview, video, or trusted news report contains those alleged comments. The couple publicly dated in 2025 before ending their relationship on good terms. The video shared with the post has been misrepresented and does not include the claimed confession.

title: Lamine Yamal’s emotional tribute to his mother despite childhood struggles
content: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly

title: No arrest made in Nolan Wells case as viral Warren Hudson claim debunked
content: Viral Facebook posts claiming Warren Hudson was arrested in the Nolan Wells death investigation are false. No arrests have been made, and Hudson has not been named a suspect. Investigators are still waiting for the state coroner’s findings and toxicology report. Officials continue to treat the case as an active investigation, with no confirmed evidence of foul play so far.

title: Nolan Wells' family seeks social media records amid missing phone data concerns
content: Nolan Wells’ family has subpoenaed several social media companies as investigators continue examining the 18-year-old’s death. The requests focus on account records and digital data after the family raised concerns about missing Snapchat content on Wells’ phone. His friend Warren Hudson has denied that anyone accessed or deleted information from the device. The investigation remains ongoing.

title: Rahul's 'advice' to PM Modi, and 3 guarantees to students over police action on protesters
content: Rahul Gandhi accused the Centre of denying him Lok Sabha speech rights. He refused to apologize for blaming Amit Shah for police brutality. Gandhi demanded the Home Minister's dismissal and an independent probe. He alleged police used pellet guns and nail-fitted lathis on students. Gandhi promised justice and accountability for the injured students.

title: What India needs to do amid emerging global challenges: Finance ministry outlines
content: The report stressed that deeper domestic reforms and quicker policy execution will be essential to alter the country's long-term economic trajectory.

title: India-US trade pact: Piyush Goyal explains the one condition to seal the deal
content: India's trade pact with the US awaits tariff competitiveness restoration for its first phase.  Minister Piyush Goyal stated India needs a comparative advantage over rival nations.  This condition must be met before the bilateral trade agreement can commence.  Meanwhile, a US legislative proposal could impose tariffs on Russian energy buyers.  India has increased its Russian crude oil purchases amid supply disruptions.

title: Five wins, nine medals assured! Indian boxers deliver flawless day at CWG 2026
content: The Commonwealth Games witnessed India's boxing squad achieving an impressive milestone by winning all five matches. Five Indian athletes have now made it to the semifinals, guaranteeing at least nine bronze medals for the country. Sakshi Choudhary and Arundhati Choudhary kick-started the victory parade with their bouts, complemented by the triumphs of Sachin Siwach, Ankush Yadav, and Narender Berwal.

title: Varanasi: Man stabs live-in partner to death after drunken fight over washing utensils
content: A live-in relationship between two gay partners in Varanasi ended tragically on Monday night.  One partner, Kush Pandey, fatally stabbed his live-in partner, Dipanshu Rai, during a quarrel.  The dispute reportedly began over washing dishes after consuming alcohol together.  Police arrested Kush Pandey at the scene and sent Dipanshu Rai's body for postmortem.  The couple had been living together for a year and often argued after drinking.

title: Explained: Why rain can't stop athletics at CWG 2026 despite safety concerns
content: Glasgow's weather challenges the 2026 Commonwealth Games athletics events.  Athletics regulations permit competition in rain if safety is maintained.  Modern facilities and drainage systems manage wet conditions effectively.  Athletes adapt to challenging weather as part of elite competition.  Reserve days are not kept due to complex scheduling and logistical issues.

title: Oil prices jump over 7% as Middle East chaos flares up, brent crude back at $90
content: Oil prices surged over seven percent on Wednesday amid renewed Middle East military actions.  This rally was also supported by industry data showing a drawdown in US crude inventories.  Renewed strikes involving the United States and Iran-backed groups reignited supply concerns.  Disruptions continued to affect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.  Analysts expect oil prices to remain volatile in the near term due to ongoing conflict.

title: India faces 100% Trump tariff threat as US Senate advances Russia Sanctions Bill - what it means
content: India has stepped up Russian crude oil purchases to make up for the deficit, helped in part by the US sanctions waiver which lapsed recently. However, India has continued to procure Russian crude.

title: Duleep Trophy: Sooryavanshi named East Zone vice-captain, Ishan Kishan to lead
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has been appointed vice-captain for the East Zone squad. He will serve as deputy to Ishan Kishan in the Duleep Trophy 2026. Experienced pacer Mohammed Shami also returns to domestic cricket action. The squad features a blend of international cricketers and emerging talent. Riyan Parag and Akash Deep are absent due to rehabilitation.

title: Sooryavanshi jumps 230 places in T20I rankings as Ishan Kishan scripts history
content: Teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has jumped 230 places in the ICC T20I batting rankings. Ishan Kishan retains his world number one position with a historic rating. Tilak Varma and Shreyas Iyer also saw gains in the rankings. Ravi Bishnoi made significant progress in the T20I bowling rankings. Zimbabwe's Ryan Burl and Blessing Muzarabani also achieved career-best rankings.

title: ICC punishes Pakistan seamers after defeat against West Indies in first Test
content: Pakistan bowlers Mohammad Abbas and Khurram Shahzad faced ICC sanctions for code of conduct breaches. Shahzad received a fine and demerit point for his aggressive celebration after a dismissal. Abbas was officially reprimanded and given a demerit point for a similar on-field action. Both players accepted responsibility for their actions, concluding the process without formal hearings. This disciplinary action follows Pakistan's opening Test defeat against the West Indies.

title: How Russell Wilson and Ciara’s $3M move transformed pediatric healing spaces
content: How Russell Wilson and Ciara’s $3 million donation transformed pediatric care at Mount Sinai Kravis Children's Hospital in New York City. Inspired by personal family hardships, the power couple funded state-of-the-art therapeutic play zones to bring hope, healing, and genuine joy to the city’s bravest young patients fighting life-threatening illnesses.

title: Rare Himalayan diamond flower blooms once in seven years, grows taller than humans
content: The Kenzo flower, also known as Padamchal, grows at high altitudes in the Himalayas. This rare alpine bloom takes seven years to produce a single flower. It survives harsh conditions and is valued for its medicinal properties by local communities. Visitors can spot this remarkable plant in various locations across the Indian Himalayas. Conservation efforts are crucial as its habitat faces potential shrinkage due to rising temperatures.

title: Sonu Sood slams Kangana Ranaut's 'Generation Gutter' remark, says think before you speak
content: Sonu Sood has responded to Kangana Ranaut's controversial remarks about young protesters. He emphasized the significant role young people play in public figures' careers. Sood stated that these young individuals are crucial for actors' success and influence. He expressed disappointment with Ranaut's 'gutter' comment, calling it shameful. Sood advised weighing words carefully, as the public holds immense power.

title: CM Vijay mobbed by fans during Chennai Metro visit after 'Jana Nayagan' release
content: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay experienced immense fan excitement during a Chennai Metro visit. Hundreds of fans gathered, creating a massive crowd at the stations. Videos of the event went viral, showcasing his significant popularity. This reception mirrors the enthusiasm seen during his film releases. His farewell film 'Jana Nayagan' also continues its successful box office run.

title: ITR filing deadline nears: How to file income tax return online - quick 15-step guide
content: The process to file the income tax return has evolved over the last few years and the income tax portal now pre-fills a lot of your tax related information drawing from information in documents such as Form 16, Form 26AS, Annual Information Statement (AIS), bank records etc.

title: 'Been in Russia for 4 months': Bihar man questions being named in NEET protest FIR
content: While overseas, a Bihar citizen asserts that police have filed charges against him for a protest he did not attend, detailed in a video reportedly shot in Russia. In response, the Kishanganj SP invited individuals with concerns to contact the police. Furthermore, the state government plans to void all cases linked to the NEET paper leak protests and will release arrested individuals in light of this decision.

title: Why Australia coach is dreaming of Ben Stokes' 'fairytale' return for Ashes
content: Australian coach Andrew McDonald desires Ben Stokes' return for the 2027 Ashes series.  He believes this would create a compelling narrative for the cricket rivalry.  Stokes retired from Test cricket earlier this year after a home series defeat.  A new England coach might persuade him to reconsider his decision to play again.  Stokes has continued playing domestic cricket, showing he still has ability.
